description: Source code for IoHwAb module configuration and digital signal handling for MPC551x MCU, including functions for setting and getting digital signals, specifically for LED4, with control mechanisms for locking, resetting, freezing, and adjusting signal states.

methods.name: IoHwAb_Set_Digital_DigitalSignal_Led4
methods.description: Sets the digital signal for LED4, considering lock status and updating the hardware channel.

methods.name: IoHwAb_Dcm_DigitalSignal_Led4
methods.description: Handles control actions for LED4 signal, including return control, reset to default, freeze, and short-term adjust.

methods.name: IoHwAb_Set_Digital
methods.description: Parameterized function to set digital signals based on signal type, currently handling LED4.

methods.name: IoHwAb_Get_Digital
methods.description: Retrieves the current level of a specified digital input signal.
